_readme: The states this platform can serve. Andhra Pradesh is the only one with data today, but every seed record carries a state key from the start so that adding a second state is a data-collection job rather than a rewrite. A state is added here first; nothing else in the codebase should ever hardcode one.

states.name: Andhra Pradesh
states.formed_note: Reorganised on 2 June 2014, when Telangana was separated. Figures before that date are for the undivided state and are never compared with figures after it.
states.districts_note: Reorganised from 13 districts into 26 in April 2022.
